name: SPIRIT
aliases: Testosterone Treatment in Prostate Cancer Survivors With Hypogonadism
question: In symptomatic hypogonadal men with undetectable PSA after prostatectomy for low-grade prostate cancer, does short-course testosterone cypionate improve sexual activity versus placebo without biochemical recurrence?

design.population: Men aged 40 years or older with low libido, erectile dysfunction, or fatigue, a mean of 2 testosterone measurements below 275 ng/dL, organ-confined Gleason 3+3 or 3+4 prostate cancer, and undetectable PSA for at least 2 years after radical prostatectomy.
design.description: Two-center, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 randomized trial
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Design, Setting, and Participants; Intervention; Results

verdictNote: Sexual activity improved over 12 weeks; no biochemical recurrences were observed.
takeaway: In hypogonadal men after prostatectomy for low-grade prostate cancer, 12 weeks of testosterone cypionate versus placebo increased sexual activity (adjusted difference 0.91 daily events, 95% CI 0.56–1.26); no biochemical recurrence was observed in either arm.
